sloka: पुत्रद्वयविहीनम् च स्नुषयापि विवर्जितम् ।अपश्यद्भवनम् राजा नष्टचन्ध्रमिवाम्बरम् ॥२-४२-२९॥
transliteration: putradvayavihīnam ca snuṣayāpi vivarjitam ।apaśyadbhavanam rājā naṣṭacandhramivāmbaram ॥2-42-29॥

translations.english: His mind tossed restlessly although he entered Kausalya's palace and climbed into the couch.
